summary: Fix security vulnerability by sanitizing Bidi Unicode control characters

approach.description: Extended _sanitize_text function to escape bidirectional Unicode control characters (U+200E-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) to prevent text direction spoofing attacks.

risks.performance_impact: Minimal - added a helper function with simple range checks
risks.edge_cases: None identified - all existing tests pass
